name: Oboro
source: A kunoichi. Trained as an assassin since she was young, Oboro was abandoned by the assassin organization she belonged to and was bought by the Queen, whom she is now serving. Called a "dog" by those around her, Oboro does not express much emotion or talk any more than is necessary.
